name: slow-loop-instruments
title: Slow-loop instruments: co-change misalignment and cold-agent drills
interface: Two tools. (1) misalignment report: mine git co-change history, compare the impact scope implied by the contract tree against the scope revealed by actual co-changes, and emit refactoring suggestions where they repeatedly disagree. (2) cold-agent drill runner: standardized comprehension/bug-localization tasks executed by a context-free agent against the repo, with counted files-read/turns as the codebase-quality trend metric.
nl_description: OPEN. The feedback that cannot be instant: ground truth about whether the decomposition matches reality. Wins get frozen into laws; misalignment reopens design nodes.
